field.label: Disk health and wear alerts
field.help: Read SMART/NVMe status from installed smartctl and report failing disks, high wear and overheating. Requires smartmontools.

field.label: SSD lifetime used limit
field.help: Alert when NVMe reported lifetime used reaches this percentage. Default 90%.

field.label: Drive temperature limit
field.help: Alert if an available SMART temperature reaches this limit in °C. Default 65 °C.
